{{Top|leg}}
'''Wagons''' were primitive land vehicles that used [[wheel]]s to transport cargo and passengers. More advanced wagons were sometimes armed, armored, and used in warfare.

The [[Anointed People]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abonshee]] used wagons pulled by animals.<ref name="Godking">{{WEGCite|story=Tests of the Godking|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref>
